{
  "dataset_name": "advanced_iot_dataset",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "root_to_shoot_wet_weight_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of root wet weight to vegetative wet weight, indicating resource allocation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized continuous measure of plant resource distribution, useful for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "df['Average wet weight of the root (AWWR)'] / (df['Average wet weight of the growth vegetative (AWWGV)'] + 1e-5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "leaf_area_per_leaf",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average area per leaf, calculated by dividing total leaf area by the number of leaves.",
      "value_range": [100.0, 600.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes leaf area by leaf count, creating a smooth continuous feature for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "df['Average leaf area of the plant (ALAP)'] / (df['Average number of plant leaves (ANPL)'] + 1e-5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dry_matter_vegetative_efficiency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of dry weight to wet weight for vegetative growth.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "efficiency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the water content versus dry matter in vegetative parts, offering a stable linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "df['Average dry weight of vegetative plants (ADWV)'] / (df['Average wet weight of the growth vegetative (AWWGV)'] + 1e-5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dry_matter_root_efficiency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of dry weight to wet weight for root growth.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "efficiency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the water content versus dry matter in roots, providing a continuous severity measure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "df['Average dry weight of the root (ADWR)'] / (df['Average wet weight of the root (AWWR)'] + 1e-5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "plant_volume_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed approximation of plant volume using height and leaf area.",
      "value_range": [9.0, 13.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a smooth, normalized composite score of overall plant size, ideal for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(df['Plant height rate (PHR)'] * df['Average leaf area of the plant (ALAP)'])"
    },
    {
      "name": "root_volume_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed approximation of root volume using length and diameter squared.",
      "value_range": [7.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous, non-linear combination of root dimensions linearized via log transformation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(df['Average root length (ARL)'] * (df['Average root diameter (ARD)'] ** 2))"
    },
    {
      "name": "chlorophyll_density_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Chlorophyll content relative to scaled leaf area.",
      "value_range": [1.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes chlorophyll by leaf area, creating a density metric that helps separate different plant states.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "df['Average  of chlorophyll in the plant (ACHP)'] / (df['Average leaf area of the plant (ALAP)'] / 100 + 1e-5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "total_dry_biomass",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of vegetative and root dry weights.",
      "value_range": [0.2, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates dry biomass into a single continuous feature, useful for establishing linear decision boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "df['Average dry weight of vegetative plants (ADWV)'] + df['Average dry weight of the root (ADWR)']"
    },
    {
      "name": "total_wet_biomass",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of vegetative and root wet weights.",
      "value_range": [1.5, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates wet biomass into a single continuous feature, providing a baseline size metric.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "df['Average wet weight of the growth vegetative (AWWGV)'] + df['Average wet weight of the root (AWWR)']"
    },
    {
      "name": "biomass_dry_wet_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of total dry biomass to total wet biomass.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the overall dry matter proportion of the entire plant, offering a robust normalized score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(df['Average dry weight of vegetative plants (ADWV)'] + df['Average dry weight of the root (ADWR)']) / (df['Average wet weight of the growth vegetative (AWWGV)'] + df['Average wet weight of the root (AWWR)'] + 1e-5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "plant_health_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of overall plant health based on chlorophyll levels, leaf area, and biomass accumulation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, non-linear assessment of plant vitality that complements deterministic formulas.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "root_development_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of root system robustness based on root length, diameter, and dry matter percentage.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes expert-like evaluation of root structure, adding a qualitative dimension to the feature space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
